reason: [Bug][native/spawn] riscv64/aarch64 spawn×extern: the SECOND worker futex-deadlocks on a glibc internal lock (`__lll_lock_wait`, val=2 — the loader-TLS/lazy-PLT family; `_dl_allocate_tls` per clone) when the FIRST worker parks INSIDE an extern C call — measured 4/6 under load (QEMU_STRACE trace in the issue; the Kof riscv runtime has NO val=2 futex: the await waits 0, the B61 channel 1, the borrow acquire LR/SC). CLASSIFIED `1.0-blocks` per `D-1.0-BLOCKS-NO-HONEST-LIMITS` (17/11, docs/lab): a real concurrency-surface deadlock IS a tracked 1.0 edge — the criterion: the deadlock fixed at root by the native/GC-spawn lane (§602 family; the mitigation candidates ride the issue: BIND_NOW / pre-resolve the externs / static TLS); the test stays (it honestly detects the bug).

reason: [Security][jvm] kof4shell (CVE-2026-114938): the HotSpot AVX-512 Base64 decode intrinsic (Intel Ice Lake+/AMD Zen 4+, JDK 17.0.6+/21/25) overflows the heap on padded inputs — unauthenticated RCE. Kof exposure measured: 87 java.util.Base64 sites in the generated JVM runtime (crypto/web/tls/acme/config) + the CLI itself. MITIGATED same cycle: -XX:-UseBASE64Intrinsics ships by DEFAULT on every JVM Kof launches (bin/kof(+.bat), the KofStdio flag helpers, the JS-driver re-exec, the debug session); KOF_B64_INTRINSICS=1 opts out for a fixed JDK (11.0.33.1/17.0.21.1/21.0.13.1/25.0.5.1/27.0.1.1). The issue tracks the default flipping back: embedded JDK >= a fixed build, proven on AVX-512 hardware.
owner: security lane; the embedded-JDK bump = the release front
